track.title: Homayoun: Tarz, Bakhtiari
track.notes: Tagged title: Tarz, Bakhtiari. A different performance from the Homayoun suites of 'Lord of Setar' and 'Setar' (no onset alignment).

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb4 and dwells most on Bb in Tarz. The line peaks at Db5 (538.4 Hz) at 1:42.7. It closes on the tonic (Bb4 → Bb4 → Bb4 → Gk4 → Bb4 → F4).
